title: Putting mice into hibernation causes a major loss of synapses
summary: Hibernation cuts down on synapses, but mice seem to retain memories anyway.
llm_summary: Researchers found that when mice are put into hibernation they shed up to half of the connections (synapses) between brain cells—a dramatic pruning that normally would be expected to erase memories.
